title: Library list
description: The Day 2 skill lab's library list, as library.json on the live-deck-data branch. scripts/library-list.mjs computes it without a model from the open and merged PRs into main that touch .agents/skills/ or use the lab PR template. It never holds a person's name.

entries.description: One per lab PR, in the order the PRs were opened.

name.description: The skill's folder under .agents/skills/, or the PR title for anything else.

kind.description: skill: the PR adds or changes a shared skill. fix: a check, test, type, architecture change or AGENTS.md line.

fixLevel.description: From the PR's Fix level section. Null when the PR doesn't say.

catches.description: A skill's description (first line), or the PR's What it catches line.

toolsPassed.description: The tools whose should-fire prompts in TESTS.md are all ticked. Empty for a fix.
